data.raw_text:
#MSNews | The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), through the Philippine Consulate in Hong Kong, confirms that one OFW is missing while one is confined to the ICU of a local hospital following the Level 5 fire that engulfed a residential complex in Tai Po, New Territories.

It also reported that a total of 23 Filipino domestic workers required welfare assistance. | via Katrina Manubay

📷 Agence France Presse

For more news updates, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.

The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) confirmed that there were 23 Filipino domestic workers affected by the Level 5 fire that engulfed a high-rise apartment complex in Hong Kong, while one remains missing.
